title: Is Anything Too Hard for the Lord?
verse: The Lord said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Will I really have a child when I am old?’ Is anything impossible for the Lord? I will return to you when the season comes round again and Sarah will have a son.” Then Sarah lied, saying, “I did not laugh,” because she was afraid. But the Lord said, “No! You did laugh.
observation: The easy answer to the question of whether anything is too hard for God is no. The hard answer is, “If God can do anything, why do we doubt Him?” This is because it is easy to declare and hard to walk out. The great thing about God is He gets us. Therefore, He does not refuse to bless us just because we do not understand how He does it. Our job is not to figure God out. Our job is to trust Him, do the best we can, and watch Him do the rest.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for constantly doing more than we can imagine.
